acceptanceEvidence: src/app/desk/sales-tax/use-tax/[periodId]/file-now-panel.tsx (wired into the page) has the Open Revenue Online button (new tab, noopener), the numbers in DR 0252 line order from src/domains/tax/use-tax-file-now.ts each with the existing Copy field, and a link to the 'I filed and paid it' return page. tests/w10-use-tax-file-now.test.ts checks the order, values and labels.

src/domains/tax/dr0252-form.ts fills the owner-supplied official 2026 form (src/domains/tax/forms/DR0252_2026.pdf) through GET /desk/sales-tax/use-tax/[periodId]/form (owner and admin only); the form is picked by the period's year, a redesigned layout is refused, and System health asks for next year's form from December. Tests read the filled PDF back field by field; the output was also inspected as an image.

docs/runbooks/colorado-filing-channels.md records where each Colorado return is filed and paid, the DR 0252 line order, the official source URLs and the dates they were checked (2026-10-16 and 2026-10-17).

The File now steps are built only from the saved filing packet (tests/w10-use-tax-file-now.test.ts compares them to a packet); the page and the form route both call requireRole OWNER/ADMIN; the panel contains no submit or pay control, only a link to the state's site and a link back to the owner's own recording form.

src/app/desk/leads/[id]/lead-actions-panel.tsx shows Create quote and Start agreement (and Go to their customer page) after conversion, including after a refresh, using the lead's saved convertedCustomerId; both open existing pages (/desk/estimates/new and /desk/agreements/new with the customer).
src/app/desk/estimates/[id]/convert-estimate-panel.tsx opens the single new draft agreement (or the agreements list when several were made) instead of only refreshing.

src/domains/agreements/unsigned-follow-up.ts and the owner screen /desk/settings/unsigned-follow-up (explanation, starting 3, restore button, audited, owner only, stale-save protection); src/domains/exceptions/unsigned-agreements.ts raises 'Follow up: <name> hasn't signed' linking to the agreement and clears when signed or cancelled. Proven in tests/w19-flow-gaps-integration.test.ts on real PostgreSQL.

UNREVIEWED_MAINTENANCE_REQUEST_DAYS is now 0 and the title is 'Review <name>'s repair request' (tests/w19-flow-rules.test.ts); the existing Today assembly query then lists a request as soon as it is submitted.

src/domains/portal/index.ts createPickupRequestForUser, called by the portal request form for the pickup kind, creates or reuses exactly one draft pickup visit with the customer's note and creates no repair request; it refuses another customer's appliance, and when it cannot tell which single rental is meant it falls back to an ordinary request for the owner to review (nothing is lost); the customer's open pickups are listed in 'Your pickup requests' in the portal. The customer sees 'we'll call you within one business day' (with Spanish). Proven in tests/w19-flow-gaps-integration.test.ts.

closeAgreementInTx now creates the draft pickup visit when a rental ends with appliances still out; src/domains/agreements/pickup-needed.ts feeds a 'Schedule <name>'s pickup' Today item for ended or ending rentals with none, and the agreement page has a 'Schedule the pickup' button (owner/admin only, safe to repeat). Proven in tests/w19-flow-gaps-integration.test.ts.

src/domains/agreements/progress.ts returns a button for every unfinished step (signature, deposit, equipment, delivery, billing) and src/components/desk/agreement-progress.tsx renders them; every target is an existing /desk page. tests/w19-flow-rules.test.ts.

externalAcceptance: Real use after the daily release: the owner filing a real Colorado use tax return with the File now panel (confirming Revenue Online's screen order, which needs a sign-in and could not be read here) and printing the filled-in form for a real period; the owner reading the new To do items on the live site. No live Stripe, customer email, SMS or spending was used.
Browser and accessibility checks of the new pages run in exact-head CI (route inventory, settings screen, use tax page).
evidence: Bundle W-10+W-19; planning commit bbd1090caf666ba98e3bd8ea2d72447660a9c524 preserved.

Local: typecheck, lint and the plain-words check pass; 9 File now and form tests (the real 2026 PDF is filled and read back, a redesigned form is refused), 4 flow-rule tests and 6 real-Postgres flow tests pass; existing Today, agreement progress, system health, filing and ending suites still pass; the filled form was also viewed as an image; exact-head CI pending.
